title: The Shared Task on Gender Rewriting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating NLP systems on a gender rewriting task, which measures their ability to generate grammatically correct Arabic sentence alternatives that match specific user gender contexts (male/female speaker and listener). The evaluation uses the MaxMatch (M2) scorer to compute Precision, Recall, and F0.5 for phrase-level edits, alongside BLEU scores against a manually annotated gold-standard blind test set.
